subject.title: fix(zalouser): clear probe timeout after auth resolves

question: Should maintainers keep requiring real Zalouser runtime proof for this timer cleanup, or explicitly override the proof gate for this PR?
rationale: The code defect is clear from source, but the OpenClaw external-PR proof gate does not treat mocked Vitest/fake-timer output as real behavior proof.

options.title: Require runtime proof
options.body: Keep the proof ask until redacted live Zalouser channel status/probe output, runtime logs, or an equivalent validation transcript shows the auth-resolved path.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the unit-level fake-timer proof for this tiny cleanup and mark proof override before merge.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proof ask until redacted live Zalouser channel status/probe output, runtime logs, or an equivalent validation transcript shows the auth-resolved path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history match for the current Zalouser probe/runtime path and can judge whether mock-only proof is enough here.
